units.source_text: 弯起手指，吹响哨子，能听见对上信号的尖锐口哨声。

en.t: Curling his fingers, he blew the whistle, and could hear the sharp answering whistle of the signal.

units.source_text: 接着，是拉着大网篮跑来跑去、爽朗的吆喝声……

en.t: Then came the brisk shouts of men running back and forth, hauling the large basket net.

units.source_text: 随着大网篮逐步接近，反而变得静悄悄了。

en.t: As the large basket net gradually drew closer, however, everything grew strangely quiet.

units.source_text: 上面不出声地放下了大网篮。

en.t: From above, they lowered the large basket net without a sound.

units.source_text: 他感到一阵紧张的警戒气氛，可到了现在这地步，就是面壁大叫也无济于事。

en.t: He sensed a tense, watchful atmosphere, but at this point even shouting at the wall would do no good.

units.source_text: 预定分量的沙子平安地吊上去之后，紧张的气氛顿时缓和了下来，似乎连空气的手感都发生了变化。

en.t: After the planned amount of sand had been safely hoisted up, the tension immediately eased, as if even the feel of the air had changed.

units.source_text: 虽然，没有一个人开口说话，但当面的谅解就此成立了。

en.t: Although no one said a word, a tacit understanding was reached there on the spot.
